## About
Classic Plumbing is a family-owned and operated plumber based in Plano, serving McKinney, Murphy, Wylie and the surrounding North Texas towns. We work on homes and businesses, from fixing leaky faucets to installing water heaters, finding slab leaks and repairing sewer lines.
We're a licensed and insured company. We follow city codes, and we handle permits and inspections when a job needs them. If something goes wrong after hours, our emergency service is there day or night.
Neighbors have given us a 4.6 rating across 289 Google reviews. One customer wrote that our office staff always replied promptly to questions, and another said we answered every question before and during the work.

## Services
- Drain cleaning: Clearing clogged drains for homes and businesses.
- Gas pipe and sewer line repair: Fixing gas lines and sewer lines so your plumbing runs safely.
- Leak detection and repair: Finding and fixing water leaks, including slab leaks under the house.
- Water heaters: Repair, replacement and installation of water heaters.
- Toilets: Omari and Trent installed a new toilet for one customer, who said they did a wonderful job.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on commercial properties?
A: Yes. We're a residential and commercial plumber, so we work on both homes and businesses.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're based in Plano and serve McKinney and the surrounding North Texas communities.

Q: Do you take care of permits and inspections?
A: Yes. We handle permits and inspections when a job calls for them.

Q: Do you stand behind your work?
A: Yes. Our work and our technicians are backed by a guarantee.
